name: MKI Password Policy
overview: Password rules and forced password changes for Jellyfin users.
description: Enforces password rules (length, character types, no username, common passwords) on the server for every client, with ready-made profiles. Lets an administrator require a new password from all users or from single users, right away or with a notice period: they cannot sign in on any device until they have set one. Accounts without a password are locked until they get a temporary password. Web-based apps show a popup users must answer; TVs get Jellyfin's message window and a change page that opens in any browser.
changelog: New settings page in the shared MKI design, with tabs for Users, Require a new password, Profiles and More settings. The header shows who the rules apply to, the state of everyone's password, open requests and the time left to set a new one. The Users tab lists everyone with search and filters, and flags accounts without a password with a Temporary password button. Before any change that could lock someone out, the page names the accounts and asks; your own account can never be locked from here. A request for everyone shows who gets one and who was already asked, with the notice period chosen in the same dialog. A temporary password is shown once, in a dialog that stays open until you confirm you copied it. Profiles can be compared side by side and tried with a test password, checked in the browser only. Settings save as soon as you change them, with undo. Works on phones and in light and dark themes.
